mapper.select: SELECT pq.qu_type AS quType, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM( CASE WHEN pq.is_right = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS rightCount FROM el_paper_qu pq INNER JOIN el_paper p ON pq.paper_id = p.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.exam_id = #{examId} AND pq.answered = 1 AND pq.is_right IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pq.qu_type ORDER BY pq.qu_type
